name: H06_chandras_outrage_hits_the_opponent_who_controls_your_creature
note: Chandra's Outrage: the 2 damage goes to the controller of the targeted creature. The target is a 3/3 that P0 owns but P1 controls (gain_control): it dies to the 4 damage and P1, its controller, loses 2 life (20 -> 18) while P0, its owner and the caster, loses nothing.
